title: Closed derived transport and covering localization for internal module sheaves
statement:
Let $S$ be any scheme with its small pro-étale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and put $R_S=p_S^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the relative internal-module tensor and its ordinary, uncompleted K-flat derived tensor with closed right adjoint [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Write $B_S$ for the section-ring sheaf reconstructed from $R_S$ and
$$E_S:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_S}(\operatorname{Sh}(S_{\mathrm{proét}},\operatorname{Ab}))\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(B_S)$$
for the section-action equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. On the target use K-flat sheaf tensor and K-injective derived internal Hom [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

Then $E_S$ is exact, its termwise derived equivalence $\mathbb E_S$ identifies these closed symmetric monoidal structures, and its tensor and Hom comparisons identify the actual evaluation and tensor--Hom adjunction maps. In particular the internal uncompleted derived tensor preserves distinguished triangles and shifts in each variable. For every $M,N$, with $D=R\mathcal Hom_{R_S}(M,R_S)$, $\mathbb E_S$ carries the canonical evaluation transpose $u_N:N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{R_S}D\to R\mathcal Hom_{R_S}(M,N)$ to the canonical sectionwise evaluation transpose for $\mathbb E_SM,\mathbb E_SN$.

Let $\{f_i:W_i\to S\}$ be a pro-étale covering, and suppose the canonical maps $f_i^{-1}R_S\to R_{W_i}$ are ring isomorphisms. Under the identification of $W_{i,\mathrm{proét}}$ with the slice site and these coefficient isomorphisms, restriction is exact and strong monoidal on derived categories, and its canonical internal-Hom comparison is an isomorphism for arbitrary unbounded inputs. These comparisons take $u_N|_{W_i}$ to $u_{N|_{W_i}}$ with its restricted dual, compatibly with the tensor--Hom adjunction. A derived morphism on $S$ is an isomorphism if and only if all its restrictions to this covering are isomorphisms. No Noetherianity, constructibility, completeness, or condition on the residue characteristics of $S$ is assumed.

In particular, let $A$ be a commutative ring, with compatible maps from its constant sheaves $A_T$ to $R_T$ on $S$ and on the covering charts. Suppose $M|_{W_i}$ is isomorphic to $R_{W_i}\otimes_{A_{W_i}}(P_i)_{W_i}$ termwise for a bounded finite free $A$-complex $P_i$, with bounds allowed to depend on $i$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Then the global native evaluation transpose $u_N$ above is an isomorphism for every unbounded $N$.

proof.text: First recover symmetry of the fixed native braiding by applying the faithful section equivalence, canceling the invertible tensorator, and using target symmetry. Take the normalized RingedSiteDualityModel, tensorator, Hom comparison and evaluation equation from the monoidal normalization lemma. The inverse tensorator agrees with t by its first clause. Apply the closed adjunction’s hom-set bijection injectively: untransposing the image of a transpose reduces to the given evaluation equation and tensorator naturality. For u_N expand its untranspose, use associativity, the Hom comparison’s naturality at the monoidal unit, and right-unitality. This gives every actual comparison in ClosedTransport.

proof.text: A term of each scalar complex has a finite basis; the zero-ring case uses the rank-zero basis. The scalar chart finite-free isomorphism gives a strict finite-free-retract package on every term. Termwise extension preserves zero objects, so each chart’s own boundedness survives. In the normalized slice duality model strict perfect evaluation is invertible. Compose the restriction factorization through the explicit identity-scalar normalization before comparing it with ringedSliceLocalizationIso. Transport through the given derived local-model isomorphism and this canonical restriction comparison, and detect invertibility on the cover. The generated slice sieve covers because the base-changed covering refines it; this also handles empty covers. Finally change from O[0] to the monoidal unit by the model’s unit isomorphism. The u_N transport formula has invertible tensor, Hom and dual comparisons, so the faithful section equivalence reflects invertibility of the native u_N.
